svg.title: FB_DoorLock - test L1: access request, unlock by the F-program, open, close, lock, channel fault
svg.text: FB_DoorLock - test L1: access request, unlock by the F-program, open, close, lock, channel fault
C = xClosed AND xClosed2, L = xLocked AND xLocked2. xUnlockReq goes to the F-program; the F-program unlocks only at standstill. Errors are latched (cleared by module reset, part B).
tick k (x 100 ms) - events change inputs before the call of that tick
tick 2 request -> xUnlockReq ; tick 5 F-program unlocked ; tick 8 door open ; tick 15 closed again -> request done ; tick 17 locked again ;
tick 20: channel 1 opens while locked -> alarm 3 at once ; tick 24: discrepancy 500 ms -> iAlarm overwritten with 1 (see text).
